name: NURS 5562
title: Adv. Health Assessment and Diagnostic Reasoning Nurse Practitioner Role: AGACNP Population Focus
description: Principles and techniques of advanced health assessment including formulation of a clinical diagnosis based upon the health assessment findings of the adult gerontology acute care patient from adolescence to elder are examined and practiced.
requirement_description: NURS 5060; open only to graduate students in the Adult Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioner concentration.
